rationale: The assistant led the customer through filter cleaning and spray arm checks, which fixed the problem, and recommended no parts. It never asked about the programme (a quick 30-minute wash), salt or rinse aid, which were likely contributing causes, and it credited the fix mainly to the spray arm without confirming. It also gave a mildly leading step in saying 'that explains why your glasses weren't getting clean' and suggested a short wash cycle to test, which was not ideal. The customer was still told to scrape plates and check the arms in future, so the result was useful.
